name: proposal
description: Proposal lifecycle management: registration, structure validation, history tracking, templates.

requirements.title: Register proposal
requirements.description: Copy or link a proposal file to spec/proposals/, validate that required sections are present (Vision, Modules, Key requirements, Design decisions for project proposals; Context, Proposed change, Impact expectation for change proposals). A successful registration also appends the registered event that opens the proposal's lifecycle to the task journal — {"event":"registered","eid":"<git_head>:<slug>","proposal":"<slug>","git_head":"<head>"} — through the map module's MappingStore, the journal's writer-owner: the module that starts a lifecycle records its start, and the proposal epic's task_created later references this event. The git head is caller-supplied, never read from git by spex; the append is idempotent by eid, so a recovery re-run appends nothing.

requirements.title: Show proposal history
requirements.description: List all proposals with their dates, show which proposals led to which spec changes and which bead actions (via spec_proposal metadata on beads).

requirements.title: Provide templates
requirements.description: Output a project proposal template or a change proposal template to stdout. Templates include all required sections with placeholder content.

requirements.title: Git-native proposals
requirements.description: Proposals are plain markdown files in spec/proposals/. No database, no external state. Everything is committed to git.

requirements.title: Bead data via stdin
requirements.description: spex log reads tracker bead data (JSON array from 'br list --json' or compatible) from stdin rather than invoking the tracker CLI directly. Usage: br list --json | spex log --proposal <ref>. HistoryViewer accepts the parsed []BeadRecord slice from its caller — no subprocess invocation inside the proposal module. The surface is declared as the api `spex log`, and its provided_by names both halves of that split: ProposalCommands reads and parses stdin, HistoryViewer consumes the slice. This module exposes three surfaces through a single command component, so provided_by is the only place in the graph that records which worker realises which — ProposalCommands' `uses` edges cannot, because they are the same three edges whichever of the three is invoked.

components.name: Registrar
components.description: Copies or links a proposal file to spec/proposals/ and validates that required sections are present. On success, appends the registered event that opens the proposal's lifecycle to the task journal through the map module's MappingStore — idempotent by eid, with the git head supplied by the caller.

components.name: HistoryViewer
components.description: Groups and renders proposal history from a bead data array supplied by the caller. Accepts parsed []BeadRecord directly — no subprocess invocation. Filters by spec_proposal:<ref> label, resolves proposal files from spec/proposals/, and writes the grouped history to an io.Writer. Usage: the ProposalCommands wrapper reads 'br list --json' (or equivalent) from stdin, parses into BeadRecord, and passes the slice to HistoryViewer.

components.name: TemplateProvider
components.description: Generates and outputs proposal templates (project and change) to stdout.

components.name: ProposalCommands
components.description: CLI entry points for spex register, spex log, and spex template. Wires Registrar, HistoryViewer, TemplateProvider into subcommands.

data_flows.name: Proposal lifecycle
data_flows.description: Proposal file → register (validate + copy + registered journal event) → spec change → impact → bead actions → history query.

apis.name: spex log
apis.description: Show proposal history and linked bead actions (reads bead JSON on stdin)

apis.name: spex template
apis.description: Output a proposal template to stdout
